summary: D-6 cupola cabin built 1927 on Roundtop Mountain, Pend Oreille County, WA; removed or destroyed in 1956 (sources differ); footings noted in photos; 3.2-mile hike.

facts.status_note: Cabin removed or destroyed in 1956 (sources differ). Photo captions on the Willhite page point to footings and the cupola site; the page does not date them.

staffing.as_of: 1927 (only Frank Algren's first-year lightning incident is recorded)

access.note: Hike from an unsigned trailhead a short way down the east side of Pass Creek Pass, reached by Forest Service Road 22 from Lake Sullivan; the route starts at the edge of the Salmo-Priest Wilderness

visit.trail_note: About 3.2 miles round trip with about 1,066 feet of gain, starting where the Shedroof Divide Trail begins. The cabin is gone, so there is nothing to climb.

events.note: D-6 cupola cabin built on the mountain
Frank Algren survived a direct lightning strike while sitting in the brand-new cabin during its first year
FFLOS and Willhite say removed (Willhite: removed or destroyed); FireLookout.com says destroyed
USGS party placed a benchmark on one of the old footings, a concrete post about 1 by 2 feet
Registered December 17, 2012 as US 1522, WA 422; nominated by Ray Kresek

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The FFLOS register says the cabin was removed in 1956, FireLookout.com says destroyed, and the Willhite page says removed or destroyed. The story reports all three and does not pick one.

notes_for_editor: Brief record checked: status gone and elevation 1970.8 m match the FFLOS and Willhite figures (6,466 ft). Access was 'unknown' in the brief; filled as public from the trail and forest-road description, with no closure in these sources. Do not mix with the Roundtop Mountain lookout in Idaho (firelookout.com/id/roundtopmtn.html; idahofirelookouts.com), which is a different tower. The Ace High Cabin on the same ridge is a separate site, not a lookout. No photos added: Willhite photo URLs were not extracted. One WebSearch used.
